name: model_op_fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule
description: Gated delta-rule linear attention recurrence (FlagGems-sglang fused_recurrent_gdn, the fla kernel behind Qwen3-Next / GDN linear attention). q, k [B, T, H, K] and v [B, T, HV, V] bfloat16/float16/float32 with HV a multiple of H (grouped value attention), g [B, T, HV] float32 log-decay (negative), beta [B, T, HV] or [B, T, HV, V] float32, scale float, initial_state [B, HV, V, K] float32 or None. Per timestep: optionally L2-normalize q and k, scale q, decay the state by exp(g), correct v by the state's prediction for k, apply beta, rank-1 update the state with the corrected v against k, then read out with q. Returns (o [B, T, HV, V] in v's dtype, final_state [B, HV, V, K] float32 or None when output_final_state is false). The recurrence runs in float32; inputs are not modified.
